verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents in-product AI insights directly. The Insights Agent delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights from Incidents, Services and Teams analytics. AI Orchestrations analyze historical events to recommend noise-reduction rules, and PagerDuty Advance adds generative incident summaries, AI-generated post-incident reviews and SRE Agent troubleshooting suggestions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI insight features; all evidence is vendor documentation.
